description: The waterway network's landing infrastructure — the `arch.neutral.dock` family every port, ferry stage, fishery, toll crossing and waterside settlement in the catalogue assumes (`docks-piers` assetPlan slug). FOUR SEPARATE AUTHORED DOCK SYSTEMS are packaged here, not one: they are shipped together because a place record needs to pick one, NOT because their pieces interlock. Judged by geometry, not by label: the vanilla dock system is a heavy tarred-piling harbour kit on Bethesda's 512-unit grid; BM&V's Dagon Fel set is a lighter Morrowind fishing-jetty system with its own post spacing; BM&V's `jets` dock pieces are ramps/steps meant to extend an existing quay, not to start a run; and HTBM's `tamu_` family is a thin lashed-plank boardwalk with broken variants, the only one that reads Argonian. Never butt a piece of one system against a piece of another mid-run — change system only at a shore end or under a building.

snapLogic.vanilla: Bethesda harbour grid. `dockstrsol01` is the plain straight, `dockstrsol02` the wide straight, `dockstrent01-04` the four shore-entry variants, `dockstr4way01` the crossing and `dockcorsol01` the corner. `dockstepsdown01/02` (+`dockstepsdownend01`) drop to the waterline — these are the boat-boarding pieces. `dockcolstr01/02` are 10–11.5 m mooring columns (`dockcolstrsign01` is the signed one, with `dockcolstrsignrope01` its hanging rope); `dockropestr01/02` are 6.9 m slack mooring ropes strung between columns. Origins are at the deck plane, so a run is laid at one height and the columns are placed against it.
snapLogic.dagonfel: BM&V's Morrowind jetty system: `dockscentre` is the straight, `dockscentrealt` its variant, `dockscentresmall` the narrow straight and `dockscentrenopost` the post-free straight for running under a building; `docks3way`/`docks4way` are the junctions, `dockscorner` the turn, `docksend`/`docksendnopost` the terminations, `dockssteps` the water stair. `dockspilings` and `dockspilingsdamage` are the free-standing pile clusters (the damaged one is our ruined-jetty piece) and `cleat` the mooring cleat.
snapLogic.jets: Extension pieces only, authored against BM&V's own quays: `dockextension`, `dockpostextension`, `dockramp`, `dockwsteps`, `dockstepsfree` (free-standing steps) and `dockracked02` (a racked/sagging deck section). They have no start piece; use them to finish or damage a run begun in another system.
snapLogic.tamu: HTBM's lashed-plank boardwalk, the Argonian-reading system: `tamu_wooddock01/02` the deck sections, `tamu_wooddockshort01` the short section, `tamu_woodplank01-04` the loose walkway planks with `tamu_woodplankbroken01-03` as their broken twins, `tamu_woodpole01` the driven pole. Deliberately irregular — these are laid, not gridded.
snapLogic.unitScale: Bethesda units; 0.0142240 m/unit. Measured extents in docks-v1.kit.json.
